आरंबणं — (Vedic for आलंबनं) Support.

आरण्यक n. N. of a class of religious and philosophical writings closely connected with the Brāhmaṇas and called Āraṇyakas because either composed in forests or studied there, (the Upaniṣads are considered to be attached to them.)
a: आरण्यक — a. [अरण्ये भवः वुञ्] Relating to or produced in a forest, wild, forest-born (usually with the words अध्याय, मनुष्य, न्याय, पथिन्, विहार, and हस्तिन् P. IV. 2. 129 Vārt). --कः A forester, an inhabitant of the woods; तपःषड्भागमक्षय्यं ददत्यारण्यका हि नः Ś. 2. 13; R. 5. 15. --कं An Āraṇyaka; it is one of a class of religious and philosophical writings (connected with the Brāhmaṇas) which are either composed in forests, or must be studied there; e. g. ऐतरेयारण्यकं, बृहदारण्यकं and तैत्तिरीयारण्यकं; अरण्येऽ नूच्यमानत्वात् आरण्यकं Bṛ. आ-रम्भित mfn. begun, undertaken.

sexual pleasure, Gaut. xxiv, 4
cessation, pause

a: आरनालं — Gruel made from the fermentation of boiled rice.

a Soma vessel [NBD.], RV. viii, 64, 11
a: आर्जीकीय — = आजींक a. --या 1 A terrestrial river. --2 N. of a river (विपाशा.)

m: आर्जीक mfn. (fr. ऋजीक [Sāy.] q.v.), belonging to the country Ṛjīka
आर्जीक (अस्), m. a particular Soma vessel [NBD.], RV.
a: आर्जीक — a. [ऋजीकस्येदं अण्] Belonging to the ऋजीक country, or a vessel called ऋजीक. --कः A lake in the ऋजोक country; (according to others) perhaps a milk-vessel or celestial-vessel in which the heavenly Soma is purified.

v: na॰ fjorBAvaH aR । 1 saralatAyAM “dUraM yAtyudaraYca romalatikA netrArjavaM DAvati” sA॰ da॰ 2 parapratAraRArAhitye sAralyaM ca dEhikaM mAnasaYca । tatra dEhikaM kuwilasaMyogarAhityam । mAnasaYca bAhyAByantare vihitanizidDayo rekarUpapravfttinivfttimattvam bAhye yaTA pravfttinivfttI antare'pi taTEva na punaH antarasTaM BAvamaprakASya bAhye anyaTApAdanam । taTA svADigatArTAgopanena yaTAjYAtArTaprakASanaYca mAnasaM sAralyaM vAcikamArjavamapi manoDInatvAt mAnasameva ArjjavaM ca samacittatvena lakzitam । A॰ ta॰ BAratavAkyena । “kzamA dvandvasahizRutvamArjavaM samacittatA” । ArjavaYca mahattvasampAdakoguRaviSezaH yaToktaM BA॰ 1 pra॰ 16 a॰ “satyaM SOcaM dayA kzAntistyAgaH santozaArjjavam । SamodamastapaH sAmyaM titikzoparatiH sutam । jYAnaM viraktirESvaryyaM SOryyaM tejobalaM smftiH । svAtantryaM kOSalaM kAntirDEryyaM mArddavameva ca । prAgalByaM praSrayaH SIlaM sahaojobalaM BagaH । gAmBIryyaM sTEryyamAstikyaMkIrttirmAno'nahaNkftiH । ete cAnye ca BagavannityA yatra mahAguRAH । prArTyAmahattvamicCadBiH” etacca jYAnasADanaM yaToktaM gItAyAm “amAnitvamadamBitvamahiMsA kzAntirArjavam । AcAryyopAsanaM SOcaM sTEryyamAtmavinigrahaH । indriyArTezu vErAgyatanahaNkAra eva ca । janmamftyujarAvyADiduHKadozAnudarSanam । asaktiranaBizvaNgaH putradAragfhAdizu । nityaM ca samacittatvamizwAnizwopapattizu । mayi cAnanyayogena BaktiravyaBicAriRI । viviktadeSasevitvamaratirjanasaMsadi । aDyAtmajYAnanizWatvaM tattvajYAnArTadarSanam । etajjYAnamiti proktam” jYAnaM jYAyate'neneti vyutpatterjYAnasADanamityarTaH svArTe aR । 3 sarale'pi । “sarvaM jihmaM mftyupadamArjavaM brahmaRaH padam” “kiM vyAjenArjave jane” rAmA॰ ।
m: आर्जव mfn. (fr. ऋजु, g. पृथ्वादि, Pāṇ. v, 1, 122), straight
honest, sincere, Kathās.
आर्जव m. N. of a teacher, VP.
आर्जव n. straightness, straight direction, Sāh.
rectitude, propriety of act or observance
honesty, frankness, sincerity, ChUp.; Āp.; Gaut.; MBh.; R.; Mn. &c.
a: आर्जवं — [ऋजोर्भावः अण्] 1 Straightness; दूरं यात्युदरं च रोमलतिका नेत्रार्जवं धावति S. D. --2 Straightforwardness, rectitude of conduct, uprightness, honesty, sincerity, open-heartedness; अहिंसा क्षांतिरार्जवं Bg. 13. 7; क्षेत्रमार्जवस्य K. 45; Bh. 2. 22. --3 Simplicity, humility; Ki. 4. 13; Mv. 5. 46.

m: आर्जवक mfn. straight, direct
आर्जवक m. N. of the ninth Sarga or creation, MBh. xii, 11566.
आर्जविन् mfn. having or showing honest behaviour, MBh.
आर्जिक m. (and f(आ) .) mutual term of address for husband and wife, L.

v: tri॰ arjjunave deSe BavaH DUmA॰ vuY । arjunAvanAmadeSaBave ।
puMstrI॰ arjjunasya gotrApatyam aSvA॰ PaY । arjjunagotrApatye striyAM wAp । tasya vizayodeSaH । rAjanyA॰ vuY । ArjjunAyanakaH । tadvizaye deSe ।

pu॰ arjjunyA apatyaM Qak । arjjunIputre “kOtse fzO “ahaM kutsamArjjuneyaM nyfYje'ham” f॰ 4, 26, 1 “ArjuneyamarjunyAH putraM kutsam” BA॰ । ArjunI ca gABIH kutsasya gAByA pratipAlitatvena tatputratvAt taTAtvam ।

pu॰ arjjunasyApatyaM bAhvA॰ iY । arjjunApatye aBimanyO । tadutpattikaTA “tataH suBadrA sOBadraM keSavasya priyA svasA । jayantamiva pOlomI KyAtimantamajIjanat । dIrGabAhuM mahoraskaM vfzaBAkzamarindamam । suBadrA suzuve bIramaBimanyuM nararzaBam । aBISca manyumAMScEva tatastamarimarddanam । aBimanyumiti prAhurArjjuniM puruzarzaBam” BA॰ A॰ pa॰ 221 a॰ । sa ca varconAmasomaputrasyAvatAraH yaToktaM BA॰ A॰ 67 a॰ । “yastu varccA iti KyAtaH somaputraH pratApavAn । so'BimanyurvfhatkIrttirarjjunasya suto'Bavat । yasyAvataraRerAjan! surAn somo'bravIdidam । nAhaM dadyAmpriyaM putraM mama prARErgarIyasam । samayaH kriyatA meza na Sakyamativarttitum । surakAryyaM hi naH kAryyamasurARAM kzitO baDaH । tatra yAsyatyayaM varccA na ca sTAsyati vE ciram । Endrirnnarastu BavitA yasya nArAyaRaH saKA । so'rjjunetyaBiviKyAto pARqoH puttraH pratApavAn । tasyAyaM BavitA putro bAloBuvi mahAraTaH । tataH zoqaSavarzARi sTAsyatyamarasattamAH! । asya zoqaSavarzasya sa saMgrAmo Bavizyati । yatrAMSA vaH karizyanti karma vIranisUdanam । naranArAyaRAByAM tu sa saMgrAmo vinA kftaH । cakravyUhaM samAsTAya yoDayizyanti vaH surAH! । vimuKAYCAtravAn sarvAn kArayizyati me sutaH । bAlaH praviSya ca vyUhamaBedyaM vicarizyati । mahAraTAnAM vIrARAM kadanaYca karizyati । sarvvezAmeva SatrURAM caturTAMSaM nayizyati । dinArdDena mahAbAhuH pretarAjapuraM prati । tato mahAraTErvvIrEH sametya bahuSoraRe । dinakzaye mahAbAhurmayA BUyaH samezyati । ekaM vaMSakaraM puttraM vIraM vE janayizyati । pranazwaM BArataM vaMSaM sa BUyoDArayizyati । etat somavacaH SrutvA taTA'stviti divOkasaH । pratyUcuH sahitAH sarvve tArADipamapUjayan । evaM te kaTitaM rAjaMstava janma pituH pituH” aBimanyuSabde'sya yudDacaryyA 295 pfzWe uktA ।

m: आर्जुनायन m. (g. अश्वादि, Pāṇ. iv, 1, 110) a descendant of Arjuna
N. of a people, VarBṛS.
आर्जुनायनक mfn. (g. राजन्यादि, Pāṇ. iv, 2, 53) inhabited by the Ārjunāyanas.
आर्जुन m. N. of Indra (= अर्जुन, q.v.), Kāṭh. 34, 3.
आर्जुनेय m. (fr. आर्जुनि), N. of Kutsa, RV.
आर्जुनि m. (fr. अर्जुन, g. बाह्व्-आदि, Pāṇ. iv, 1, 96), a descendant of Arjuna, MBh.
a: आर्जुनिः — [अर्जुनस्य अपत्यं इञ्] The son of Arjuna, अभिमन्यु.

v: tri॰ arkasya gotram haritA॰ PaY । arkasya 1 gotre । tataH caturarTyAM aSvA॰ PiY । ArkAyaRiH tatsannikfzwadeSAdO॰ tri॰ arkasyAyanAya sUryyalokasya prAptaye hitam aR pUrvvapadAditi Ratvam । sUryalokagatisADane 2 yajYAdO । “ArkAyaREH zoqaSaBiSca brahmaMstezAM Paleneha ca nAgato'smi” BA॰ Anu॰ 104 a॰ ।
m: आर्कायण, mfn. (fr. अर्क, g. अश्वादि, Pāṇ. iv, 1, 110) and आर्कायणि, mfn. (g. कर्णादि, Pāṇ. iv, 2, 80) coming from or relating to Arka or the sun; m. a ceremony, MBh.
आर्क mfn. (fr. अर्क), belonging or relating to the sun, BhP.
coming from the plant Calotropis Gigantea, VarBṛS.
आर्क m. an amulet made of the Arka plant, Kauś.
आर्कलूषायण m. (g. हरितादि, Pāṇ. iv, 1, 100) a descendant of Ārkalūṣa.
आर्कलूषायणि m. f. (g. कर्णादि, Pāṇ. iv, 2, 80) a descendant of Ārkalūṣa.

m: आर्कलूष m. (fr. अर्कलूष, g. विदादि, Pāṇ. iv, 1, 104), a descendant of Ārkalūṣa.
आर्कम् (for आ-अर्कम्) ind. as far as the sun, even to the sun inclusively, BhP. x, 14, 40.

s: puM, (arkasyApatyaM । arka + iY .) arkaputtraH । SanEScaraH । iti jyotiHSAstraM ॥ (vEvasvatamanuH, sugrIvaH, karRaSca .)

of Yama, T.
of a Manu, T.
of Sugrīva, T.
of Karṇa, T.
a: आर्किः — [अर्कस्य अपत्यं इञ्] A son of अर्क, epithet of (1) Yama, (2) the planet Saturn, (3) Karṇa, (4) Sugrīva, (5) वैवस्वतमनु.

m: आर्क्षाकायण see गलूनस (p. 1326).

a: आर्क्ष — (र्क्षी f.) [ऋक्षस्येदं अण्] Stellar, regulated by stars or pertaining to them. --र्क्षः A son or descendant of Ṛkṣa. --Comp. --वर्षः a stellar year or revolution of a constellation.

m: आर्क्ष—वर्ष m. a stellar year or revolution of a constellation, L.

a: आर्क्षोद — [ऋक्षोद-अण्] Inhabiting the mountain Ṛkṣoda.

m: आर्क्ष्य, m. and आर्क्ष्यायणी, f. (fr. ऋक्ष, g. गर्गादि, Pāṇ. iv, 1, 105), a descendant of Ṛkṣa, SV.
आ-रोध m. siege, Hit.
आ-रोध &c. See आ- √ 2. रुध्.

(fr. √ 1. रुध् = √ रुह्), mounting, ascent [Pischel and NBD.] RV.

आ-रोढृ m. one who ascends or rises, Yājñ.
आ-रोचक See आ-√ रुच्.
आ-रोचन mfn. shining, bright, Nir.
a: आरोचन — a. Shining.

m: आ-रोग m. one of the seven suns at the end of a period of the world, TĀr.; AitĀr. (cf. आ-राग.)
आ-रोग See आ-√ रुज्.
आरोग्या f. N. of Dākṣāyaṇī
आरोग्याम्बु n. healthful water, Bhpr.

s: klI, (arogasya BAvaH । zyaY .) vyADyaBAvaH । tatparyyAyaH । anAmayaM 2 । ityamaraH ॥ pAwavaM 3 lAGavaM 4 vArttaM 5 । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥ (“ArogyaM tat suKAvahaM” । iti SArNgaDaraH ॥ “DarmmArTakAmamokzARAmArogyaM mUlamuttamam” । “suKasaMjYakamArogyam,” “vedADyayanaSabdASca suKo vAyuH pradakziRaH । paTi veSmapraveSe tu vidyAdArogyalakzaRam ॥” iti carakaH ॥ “suKamAtraM samAsena sadvfttasyEtadIritaM । ArogyamAyurarTo vA nAsadBiH prApyate nfBiH” ॥ iti suSrutaH ॥)
v: na॰ arogasya BAvaH zyaY । rogaSUnyatve “ArogyaM vittasampattirgaNgAsmaraRajaM Palam” prA॰ ta॰ pu॰ vESyaM kzemaM samAgamya SUdramArogyameva ca” manuH । “DarmArTakAmamokzARAmAragyaM sADanaM yataH” vEdya॰ ।
m: आरोग्य n. (fr. अ-रोग), freedom from disease, health, MBh.; R.; Suśr.; Mn.; Gaut.; Āp.
a particular ceremony
आरोग्य mfn. healthy
giving health, L.
a: आरोग्यं — [अरोगस्य भावः ष्यञ्] Freedom from disease, good health --Comp. --शाला an hospital.

k.v: अनामयं स्यादारोग्यं चिकित्सा रुक्प्रतिक्रिया। भेषजौषधभैषज्यान्यगदो जायुरित्यपि॥

s: strI, (ArogyArTA SAlA । maDyapadalopikarmmaDArayaH .) ArogyadAnagfhaM । cikitsAlayaH । yaTA, -- “DarmmArTakAmamokzARAmArogyaM sADanaM yataH । atastvArogyadAtA ca naro Bavati sarvvadaH ॥ ArogyaSAlAM kurvvIta mahOzaDaparicCadAM । vidagDavEdyasaMyuktAM bahvannarasasaMyutAM ॥ vEdyastu SAstravit prAjYo dfzwOzaDaparAkramaH । ozaDImUlatattvajYaH samudDaraRakAlavit ॥ balavIryyavipAkajYaH SAlimAMsOzaDIgaRe । tyAgivaddehinAM tadvadanukUlaH priyaMvadaH” ॥ iti vEdyakaM ॥
v: strI ArogyArTA SAlA SA॰ ta॰ । cikitsArTe rAjAdikArite gfhaBede tatkaraRaprakAro vEdyake ukto yaTA “DarmArTakAmamokzARAmArogyaM sADanaM yataH । atastvArogyadAtA ca naro Bavati sarvadaH । ArogyaSAlAM kurvIta mahOzaDaparicCadAm । vidagDavEdyasaMyuktAM bahvannarasasaMyutAm । vEdyastu SAstravit prAjYo dfzwOzaDaparAkramaH । ozaDImUlatattvajYaH samudDaraRakAlavit । balavIryyavipAkajYaH SAlimAMsOzaDIgaRe । tyAgivaddehinAM tadvadanukUlaHpriyaMvadaH”
m: आरोग्य—शाला f. a hospital, L.
आरोग्य—चिन्ता-मणि m. N. of wk.
आरोग्य—माला f. N. of wk.
आरोग्य—पञ्चक n. a remedy against fever, Bhpr.
आरोग्य—प्रतिपद्-व्रत n. a ceremony for gaining health.

v: na॰ Arogye rogaSUnyatve tannimittakaM snAnam । roganirmuktO karttavye snAne tatra nakzatrAdikamuktaM jyo॰ ta॰ । “vyAdityezu carezu Sakradinakftpuzyogracandrezu ca krUrAhavyatipAtavizwidivasezvindAvaSaste taTA । kendrasTezvaSuBezu kAmatiTizu snAnaM gadonBuktitaH SastraM tatra na SoBanAraviBujaNgarkzendusadvAsArAH” Buja॰ BIma॰ pa॰ ।

m: आरोग्य—ता f. health, R.
आरोग्य—वत् mfn. healthy, L.

v: na॰ ArogyArTaM vratam । varAhapurARokte mAGaSuklasaptamImAraBya vatsaraparyyantaM pratiSuklasaptamItiTi karttavye sUryyavrataBede । yaTA “ataHparaM mahArAja! vratamArogyasaMjYitam । sitAyAM mAGamAsasya saptamyAM samupozitaH” ityupakramya “zazWyAYcEva kftAhAraH saptamyAmupavAsakft । azwamyAYcEva BuYjIta eza eva viDirmataH । anena vatsaraM pUrRaM viDinA yo'rccayedravim । tasyArogyaM DanaM DAnyamiha janmani jAyate” hemA॰ bra॰ varA॰ pu॰ idamArogyasaptamIvratatvena tatroktam ।
m: आरोग्य—व्रत n. an observance for procuring health.
आरोग्यय Nom. to wish health.

s: puM, (AN + ruh + GaY .) dErDyaM । varastriyAH SroRiH । ityamaraH ॥ (yaTA mAGe “ArohErniviqavfhannitambavimbEH” .) avarohaH । ArohaRaM । gajArohaH । samucCrayaH । iti medinI ॥ (“Arohamiva ratnAnAM pratizWAnamiva SriyaH” । iti rAmAyaRe .) parimARaviSezaH । nitambaH । iti hemacandraH ॥ (Arohati yaH । AN + ruh + ac । nizAdI । yaTA, harivaMSe, -- “aSvASca paryyaDAvanta hatArohA diSo daSa” .)

m: आ-रोह m. one who mounts or ascends, a rider (on a horse &c.), one who is seated in a carriage, MaitrS.; R.
ascent, rising, creeping up, mounting, Śak.; Kathās.; R.
haughtiness, pride, Kathās.
elevation, elevated place, altitude, R.
a heap, mountain, R.
increase, Sāh.
a woman's waist, the swell of the body, R.; BrahmaP.; Śiś.
length, L.
a particular measure, L.
descending (= अव-रोह ?), L.
a chief elephant-driver, L.
a: आरोहः — [आ-रुह्-घञ्] 1 One who mounts, a rider, as in अश्वारोह, स्यंदनारोह; सारोहाणां च वाजिनां Rām.; one who is seated in a carriage. --2 Ascent, rising, mounting, ascending, riding. --3 An elevated place, elevation, altitude, height; नगाद्यारोह उच्छ्रायः Ak. --4 Haughtiness, pride. --5 A mountain, a heap. --6 A woman's waist; the buttocks; सा रामा न वरारोहा Udb.; आरोहैर्निबिडबृहन्नितंबबिंबैः Śi. 8. 8. --7 Length. --8 A kind of measure. --9 A mine. --10 Descending.

k.v: दारेषु च गृहाः श्रोण्यामप्यारोहो वरस्त्रियाः। व्यूहो वृन्देऽप्यहिर्वृत्रेऽप्यग्नीन्द्वर्कास्तमोपहाः॥

a: आरुह् — {c1c} P. 1 To ascend, mount, bestride, get upon (with acc., sometimes loc.); सिंहासनमारुरोह K. 111; आरुरुहू रथादिषु Bk. 14. 8; आरूढकुलालचक्रमिव Mu. 5. 5 mounted on a potter's wheel; 7. 12. --2 To ride upon, get ascendancy over, domineer over (fig.); वृषल भृत्यमिव मामारोढुमिच्छसि Mu. 3; Pt. 1. 36. --3 To venture upon, undertake, enter upon, make; प्रतिज्ञामारोढुं पुनरपि चलत्येष चरणः Mu. 3. 30, 27; so यौवनारूढ, योगारूढ. --4 To attain, gain, get to, reach; सौंदर्यस्य पारमारूढा न वा Dk. 88; Ki. 2. 13; तुलां यदारोहतिदंतवाससा Ku. 5. 34; आरुरोह कुमुदाकरोपमां R. 19. 34. The senses of this root are modified according to the noun with which it is joined; आरूढरुषा Ku. 7. 67 excited to anger; तदागमारूढगुरुप्रहर्षः R. 5. 61; मंत्रिपदमारूढः Mu. 6; तर्कारूढा 6. 19 engaged in guessing; Ś. 5. 9; शीघ्रं बुद्धिमारोहति Ś. B. strikes the mind; यौवनपदवीमारूढः attained his majority; अवस्थांतरमारूढा M. 3; संशयं पुनरारुह्य H. 1. 7 running a risk; संशयमारुरोह शैलः Ki. 13. 16. --Caus. (रोह-प-यति) 1 To cause to go up or ascend, raise up, elevate; अमात्योऽस्मान्पुरातनीमवस्थामारोपयिष्यति Mu. 2 will raise or elevate; शूलानारोपयेत् Y. 2. 273; आरोपितामनोविषयमात्मनः Ku. 6. 17. --2 To cause to mount or sit (on oneself) (Atm.); करेणुरारोहयते निषादिनं Śi. 12. 5. --3 To cause to grow, plant (lit.). --4 To establish, instal, seat (fig.); राज्ये चारोपिता वयं Mu. 7. 18; इत्यारोपितपुत्रास्ते R. 15. 91. --5 To cause, produce, bring out; उष्माणं K. 105; प्रणयं 134, 142; आरोपितप्रीतिरभूत् 173, 212; प्रतापमारोपयितुं 110, 119 show or exhibit. --6 To place, fix, direct; अंकमारोप्य placing in the lap; R. 3. 26, 14. 27; Ku. 1. 37; चक्षुः˚ cast a look at; Pt. 1. 243; आशीर्वादमारोपयंतः Ki. 18. 46 conferring or pronouncing; आभरणभारमंगेषु नारोपयंति K. 203 put or wear; पत्रे आरोपितं कुरु Ś. 6 commit to paper; आरोप्यते शिला शैले H. 2. 47. --7 To entrust to, appoint to, charge with; मंत्रिणि राज्यभारमारोप्य K. 57; अमात्यपदे आरोपितः Pt. 1. --8 To cause to go to or attain a particular state; करतलं कर्णपूरतामारोपितं K. 60; आरोपय गरीयस्त्वं 207 raise to greatness; 315; Dk. 118. --9 To ascribe, attribute, impute; आत्मन्यारोपिताभिमानाः K. 108, 185; छाया हि भूमेः शशिनो मलत्वेनारोपिता शुद्धिमतः प्रजाभिः R. 14. 40. --10 To string (as a bow); धनुरारोपयन् U. 4; तं देशमारोपितपुष्पचापे Ku. 3. 35; Bk. 14. 8.

आर्य [cf. Old Germ. êra; Mod. Germ. Ehre; Irish Erin.]
a: आर्य — a. [ऋ-ण्यत्] 1 Āryan. --2 Worthy of an Ārya. --3 Worthy, venerable, respectable, honourable, noble, high; यदार्यमस्यामभिलाषि मे मनः Ś. 1. 22; so आर्यवेषः respectable dress; oft. used in theatrical language as an honorific adjective and a respectful mode of address; आर्यचाणक्यः, आर्या अरुंधती &c.; आर्य revered or honoured Sir; आर्ये revered or honoured lady. The following rules are laid down for the use of आर्य in addressing persons:-- (1) वाच्यौ नटीसूत्रधारावार्यनाम्ना परस्परं . (2) वयस्येत्युत्तमैर्वाच्यो मव्यैरार्येति चाग्रजः . (3) ( वक्तव्यो) अमात्य आर्येति घेतरैः . (4) स्वेच्छया नाममिविंप्रैविंप्र आर्येति चेतरैः . S. D. 431. --4 Noble, fine, excellent. --र्यः 1 N. of the Hindu and Iranian people, as distinguished from अनार्य, दस्यु and दासः विजानीह्यार्याव्ये च दरयवः Rv. 1. 51. 8. --2 A man who is faithful to the religion and laws of his country; कर्तव्यमाचरन् कार्यमकर्तव्यमनाचरन् . तिष्ठति प्रकृताचारे स वा आर्य इति स्मृतः ... --3 N. of the first three castes (as opp. to शूद्र). --4 A respectable or honourable man, esteemed person; वृत्तेन हि भवत्यार्यो न धनेन न विद्यया Mb. --5 A man of noble birth. --6 A man of noble character. --7 A master, owner. --8 A preceptor. --9 A friend. --10 A Vaiśya. --11 A father-in-law (as in आर्यपुंत्र). --12 A Buddha. --13 (With the Buddhists) A man who has thought on the four chief principles of Buddhism and lives according to them. --14 A son of Manu Sāvarṇa. --र्या 1 N. of Pārvatī. --2 A mother-in-law. --3 A respectable woman. --4 N. of a metre, see Appendix. --Comp. --अष्टशतं title of a work of Ārya Bhaṭṭa consisting of eight hundred verses. --आवर्तः [आर्या आवर्तंते अत्र] ‘abode of the noble or excellent (Āryas);’ particularly N. of the tract extending from the eastern to the western ocean, and bounded on the north and south by the Himālaya and Vindhya respectively; cf. Ms. 2. 22; आसमुद्रात्तु वै पूर्वादासमुद्राच्च पश्चिमात् . तयोरेवांतरं गिर्योः (हिमवद्विंध्ययोः) आर्यावर्तं विदुर्बुधाः; also 10. 34. --गृह्य a. [आर्यस्य गृह्यः पक्षः] {1} to be respected by the noble {2} a friend of the noble, readily accessible to honourable men; तमार्यगृह्यं निगृहीतधेनुः R. 2. 33. {3} respectable, right, decorous. --देशः a country inhabited by the Āryas. --पुत्रः {1} son of an honourable man. {2} the son of a spiritual preceptor. {3} honorific designation of the son of the elder brother; of a husband by his wife; or of a prince by his general &c. {4} the son of the father-in-law, i. e. a husband (occurring in every drama; mostly in the vocative case in the last two senses). --प्राय a. {1} inhabited by the Āryas. {2} abounding with respectable people. --भट्टः N. of a renowned astronomer, the inventor of Algebra among the Hindus; he flourished before the 5th century of the Christian era. --भावः honourable character or behaviour. --मार्गः the path or course of the respectable, a respectable way. --मिश्र a. respectable, worthy, distinguished. --(श्रः) a gentleman, a man of consequence; (pl.) {1} worthy or respectable men, an assembly of honourable men; आर्यमिश्रान् विज्ञापयामि V. 1. {2} your reverence or honour (a respectful address); नन्वार्यमिश्रैः प्रथममेव आज्ञप्तं Ś. 1; आर्यमिश्राः प्रमाणं M. 1. --युवन् m. an Āryan youth. --रूप a. having only the form of an Āryan, a hypocrite, impostor. --लिंगिन् m. an impostor; Ms. 9. 260. --वृत्त a. virtuous, good, pious; Ms. 9. 253; R. 14. 55. --(त्तं) the conduct of an Āryan or nobleman; Ms. 4. 175. --वेश a. well-clothed, having a respectable dress, fine. --व्रत a. observing the laws and ordinances of the Āryans or noblemen. --(तं) the duty of an Āryan. --श्वेतः a noble or honourable man. --संघः the whole body of the Āryans. --सत्यं a noble or sublime truth; (there are four such truths forming the chief principles of Buddhism). --हलं ind. [cf. P. I. 1. 47] forcibly. --हृद्य a. liked by the noble.
